verdicts.quote: Default schedule: offsets -3, 0, +7, +14, +30 days relative to the invoice due date (negative = before, 0 = on the due date).
statuses {draft, open, paid, void}: only `open` qualifies. ... Material exclusion: credit notes, refunds and write-offs are not modelled
verdicts.missing: Disputed status is left undecided (G-6) and payment plans are not mentioned; a builder must decide whether either stops the sequence.

verdicts.quote: Partially paid invoices are eligible and the reminder states the remaining balance.
Product decision: per-invoice pause/opt-out of reminders (e.g. a disputed invoice). Left out of scope (REQ-0 does not ask for it); an admin can turn reminders off account-wide.
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing customer do-not-contact/paused/unsubscribed state is honoured, and whether billing reminders are exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: Each `(invoice, offset)` is claimed atomically before sending so that two overlapping sweeps send one email.
An invoice is eligible when, at the moment a reminder would be sent (not when the schedule was computed), all hold
At most 3 attempts per reminder, at least 60 minutes apart, only within the account-local date of the first attempt.
verdicts.missing: No escalation to a person on repeated failure; failures only appear in history and R-9 excludes alerting/paging.

verdicts.quote: a sweep processes invoices in bounded batches ... when the provider throttles, the R-4 transient-retry rules apply
verdicts.missing: The provider rate limit and the batch size/pacing are unresolved (G-4); how to pace a large batch within the limit is not stated.

verdicts.quote: its step date is on or after the setting's `effective_from` (R-1; a save never fires reminders for dates before it).
Reminder time: 09:00 in the account's time zone (UTC when the account has none).
verdicts.missing: Uses the account's zone, not the customer's local time; weekends and holidays are only listed as not covered, leaving their handling unstated.

verdicts.quote: English-language email; dates shown as `20 Mar 2026`; money as ISO currency code plus amount, `USD 1,000.00`.
permanent fails at once with no retry; no recipient records `skipped-no-recipient`, and a later step sends normally if an address has been added by then.
verdicts.missing: Bounces after provider acceptance are not handled (G-3): whether a bouncing address stops later steps or alerts someone is undecided.

verdicts.quote: A reminder is one email to the invoice's single customer billing email address.
The invoice detail screen shows a Reminders list for that invoice, newest first: offset, step date, status, send/attempt time (account time zone), recipient address
Body ... business name, invoice number, remaining balance (`USD 1,000.00`), due date, days relative, and a payment link only if the product has one (G-5).
verdicts.missing: Whether the payment link expires, and what happens if it has by the time the reminder is read.

verdicts.quote: only admin may save (the other two are the groups with distinct observable behaviour: other users may view, customers/unauthenticated see nothing)
An admin can enable or disable, and edit the offsets, in a settings screen.
verdicts.missing: No preview or dry-run; per-customer off and manual resend are excluded as out of scope rather than provided.

verdicts.quote: status, send/attempt time (account time zone), recipient address, and attempt count for `failed`
verdicts.missing: Failures are visible, but nothing shows what the system will send next (pending steps are not stored or displayed).

verdicts.quote: Maximum reminders ever sent for one invoice = number of offsets (A-6, A-8).
Invoice status, balance, due date, open date | invoice store (existing, unobserved), read-only here
